body.message:
Good Morning Abrar,

I hope you are doing well.

We sincerely apologize for the delay and appreciate your patience. We have received an update from our Finance Team regarding your refund for one night.

Based on the bank details provided, we have been informed that the bank transfer may not be successful due to an issue with the intermediary bank.

To avoid any further delay, if you have a relative or friend in Dubai, you may authorize them to collect the refund in cash on your behalf.

Please let us know how you would prefer to proceed, and we will be happy to assist you accordingly.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
